message.content: In the conversation with Li Hua, Wolfgang Schulz proposes a couple of new hobbies. First, he suggests playing "Hey Jude," which Li Hua agrees to and mentions he will offer to help arrange the next jam session. Additionally, Wolfgang expresses enthusiasm about joining Li Hua and Yuriko for a jam session, indicating his interest in music-related activities. Furthermore, Wolfgang mentions that he is thinking of focusing more on his drumming this year, suggesting he might start engaging in this hobby as well. Thus, the new hobbies proposed by Wolfgang Schulz to Li Hua involve playing music, specifically through drumming and participating in jam sessions.
